title: Sources: Cognition is considering raising $2B or more at a $75B valuation, after raising over $3B in 2026 so far, including $2B at a $48B valuation in September (Rebecca Torrence/Bloomberg)
summary: Rebecca Torrence / Bloomberg: Sources: Cognition is considering raising $2B or more at a $75B valuation, after raising over $3B in 2026 so far, including $2B at a $48B valuation in September — Artificial intelligence coding startup Cognition AI Inc. is in funding talks at a $75 billion valuation, just two months …
